memories.text: The Meridian billing service exposes `POST /v3/invoices/reconcile` at `https://api.meridian-internal.dev`. Every call needs the header `X-Meridian-Tenant: acct_7fdc21` and is rate limited to 12 requests per minute; exceeding that returns HTTP 429 with the body code `RECONCILE_THROTTLED`. The limit is per tenant, not per API key, so parallel workers sharing a tenant still collide. Retries must therefore be spaced by tenant, not by process, and the client library does not do that for you.
